title: Save portable edit History and named snapshots
notes: Adds a dockable History panel, portable per-photo and per-virtual-copy .rrhistory companions, immutable named snapshots, branching and bounded storage. History failures preserve saved edits and unreadable or newer files. Numeric labels show before and after values, including masks, HSL and grading. Library develop actions and background assistant completion record steps; metadata-only changes do not. New History strings use English pending translation in non-English overlays.
